annotations.title: Show your Pixly balance and this month's spend

description: Shows the signed-in user's balance, this month's spend so far and projected total, and what awake servers cost per hour. Call it when the user asks about their balance or spending, or wants to add funds. It cannot add funds or take payments; funds are added in the Pixly dashboard, which dashboardUrl links to.
name: getBalance
title: Show your Pixly balance and this month's spend
